stories.title: Kenya and DR Congo agree to restore diplomatic ties
stories.summary: Kenya President William Ruto and DR Congo leader Felix Tshisekedi agreed to restore full diplomatic ties after tensions rooted in the conflict in eastern DR Congo. The two countries committed to respecting sovereignty and non-interference.

stories.title: Russian warship hit by suspected drone attack at Libyan port
stories.summary: A Russian warship was hit by a suspected drone attack at a port in eastern Libya; the eastern Libyan government said the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia. Zelensky says Ukraine was behind the strike.

stories.title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal
stories.summary: COP31 in Antalya collapsed without an agreement after rows over fossil fuels and climate finance, ending as the longest-running climate summit in UN history. The Australian prime minister, whose country co-hosted the talks, blamed difficult geopolitical times.

stories.title: Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble after Russian strike on Ukrainian town
stories.summary: Rescuers pulled a 7-year-old boy from the wreckage of a residential building in Dymer, where at least 11 people died in the attack. Ukrainian officials reported more than 70 strikes across 10 regions as of Sunday evening.

stories.title: More details emerge on alleged spying tied to former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
stories.summary: The New York Times reports that Alice Huang stayed in contact with an officer of the Chinese Ministry of State Security from spring 2025 until this fall, a period overlapping her affair with former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The report deepens the national-security questions that already cost Huang the top job at the AI chip giant.

stories.title: Walmart opens Black Friday shopping to Meta Muse AI agent
stories.summary: The Walmart Agent Gateway is now live with Meta Muse support, letting the AI assistant browse and buy on the retailer site for Black Friday, while Amazon and eBay continue blocking AI agents. Walmart says support for more apps and agents is on the way.

stories.title: How GIC and Baillie Gifford bet big on Anthropic before its IPO
stories.summary: Notable Capital, GIC and Baillie Gifford detail their early Anthropic bets: GIC led the AI lab Series G at a 380 billion dollar valuation and returned to co-lead the pre-IPO round at 965 billion. The account lands days after the record-breaking Nasdaq debut of the AI lab.

stories.title: San Francisco AI boom is riding high, but crash worries are growing
stories.summary: Workers at the epicenter of the AI industry say the sector feels overheated, even as the boom keeps transforming the San Francisco economy. The piece captures growing unease that the current wave may not be sustainable.

stories.title: Browns mailbag: Deshaun Watson future, the Garrett trade and a playoff chase few saw coming
stories.summary: At 6-4 and flexed into Sunday Night Football against the Raiders, the Browns are unexpectedly in the AFC playoff race. The Athletic mailbag digs into the contract-year surge of Deshaun Watson (six game-winning drives) and the Myles Garrett trade.

stories.title: NFL playoff picture: bye-week Browns in the mix for AFC No. 7 seed
stories.summary: The updated Week 11 bracket keeps Cleveland (6-4, coming off its bye) in the fight for the final AFC playoff spot alongside the surging Texans. The Browns can strengthen their case when they host Las Vegas on Sunday night in Week 12.

stories.title: AP Top 25: Ohio State crashes to No. 25 after Nebraska loss
stories.summary: Ohio State fell to No. 25, the very bottom of the AP Top 25, after the 31-28 loss at Nebraska on Saturday. It is the third defeat in four games for the Buckeyes, all to unranked teams, since quarterback Julian Sayin went out injured in mid-October.

stories.title: Ohio State falls out of the coaches poll after Nebraska upset
stories.summary: A week after returning to the rankings at No. 17, Ohio State dropped out of the coaches poll entirely following the 31-28 loss at Nebraska. It was the third Buckeyes loss in four weeks, leaving playoff hopes nearly gone.
